# FG-AGENT-0001

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `manifest_rejects_path_outside_claude_dir` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: エージェントの部品の形が正しくありません（part.toml、ファイルの置き場所、種類、大きさ）。部品を直してください。
- en: The agent part is not well-formed (part.toml, file locations, kind or size). Fix the part.
- id: Bagian agen tidak berbentuk benar (part.toml, lokasi berkas, jenis, atau ukuran). Perbaiki bagian tersebut.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A1 (ADR-0032 §2): forge-agent's part lint refused a part directory or a lock entry. `reason`: `manifest_missing`, `manifest_syntax` (TOML error or an unknown key — nothing is ignored), `manifest_not_utf8`, `slug_invalid`, `kind_unknown`, `version_invalid` (semver), `require_invalid`, `capability_unknown` (exec / network / permissions / fs-write only), `no_files`, `path_not_allowed` (outside `.claude/` and not `CLAUDE.md` / `.mcp.json`, `..`, `.git`, absolute, a drive letter, a per-checkout file such as `.claude/settings.local.json`), `path_characters` (non-ASCII, backslash, colon, control characters, a trailing dot or space), a path not in the canonical case (`.Claude/`, `claude.md`), `path_length`, `duplicate_file` (also two paths that differ only by letter case), `file_missing` (listed, not in the directory), `file_not_declared` (in the directory, not listed), `not_a_regular_file` (a symlink), `too_many_files` (> 200), `too_large` (> 1 MiB), `hook_not_node` (a script under `.claude/hooks/` that is not .js / .cjs / .mjs), `mcp_file_outside_mcp_part`, `file_not_utf8`, `settings_json_invalid`, `mcp_json_invalid`, `json_invalid`. Nothing was published or written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`gstn agent verify --part <dir> --json` lists every problem with its `reason` and `subject` (the path or field). The part's own `part.toml` and directory listing are the input; nothing on the server is involved.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the part: put files only under `.claude/` (or `CLAUDE.md`, `.mcp.json` for an mcp part), list every file in `files`, drop symlinks, keep within 200 files and 1 MiB, use a semver `version`.
